sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: The AdS/CFT correspondence, an exact duality between quantum gravity on a (d+1)- dimensional asymptotically-AdS space and a d-dimensional CFT deﬁned on its bound- ary, has signiﬁcantly advanced our understanding of quantum gravity, as well as pro- vided a powerful framework for studying strongly-coupled quantum ﬁeld theories. One aspect of this duality is a remarkable relationship between geometry and entanglement.

sections.title: Quantum error correction in holographic codes
sections.extract: In this section we study the error correction properties of our holographic codes in more detail. The idea that a CFT with a gravity dual must have error correcting properties was recently proposed in [1], and in this section we will see that our holographic codes illustrate many aspects of the proposal of [1] quite explicitly.

sections.extract: Stabilizer codes have been extensively studied in quantum coding theory, and are often used in applications to fault-tolerant quantum computing [43]. sections.title: Black holes and holography
sections.extract: In holographic codes, bulk operators are reconstructed only on a subspace of the bound- ary Hilbert space. sections.title: A Perfect tensor examples
sections.extract: In this section we will present the 5-qubit code, the 3-qutrit code and discuss possibil- ities of constructing perfect tensors with a larger number of legs. The 5-qubit code is a qubit stabilizer code of the form introduced in section 5.7 whereas the 3-qutrit code can be described through a natural generalization of the stabilizer formalism to higher spin dimensions.
